001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseOneTimeFactor;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
010
011public class SDRHyderFactor extends BaseOneTimeFactor {
012        
013        public SDRHyderFactor() {
014                super(SDRPoints.HYDER_FLEET);
015        }
016
017        @Override
018        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
019                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderArrestDone")) {
020                        return "Hyder arrested for treason against the Sindrian Diktat";
021                }
022                return "Hyder pledges support for Achilles";
023        }
024
025        @Override
026        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(BaseEventIntel intel) {
027                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
028                        @Override
029                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
030                                
031                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hyderArrestDone")) {
032                                        tooltip.addPara("Oxana Hyder was arrested and stripped of command at the order of "
033                                                        + "Chief High Inspector-General Dolos Macario.\n\nShe is accused of plotting to defect to the usurper Achilles, "
034                                                        + "providing material assistance to terrorists, theft of naval assets, smuggling, spreading defeatism,"
035                                                        + " and for conspiracy to assassinate the Supreme Executor."
036                                                + "This is a serious blow to the morale of the Sindrian Diktat Navy.",
037                                                0f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), "Oxana Hyder'");
038                                }
039                                else {
040                                        tooltip.addPara("Oxana Hyder has thrown her support behind Achilles Andrada, bringing with her the "
041                                                + "Askonia System Defense Armada and mid-level elements of the Sindrian Diktat Navy. "
042                                                + "This is a serious blow to Hector Andrada's Absolutist faction.",
043                                                0f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), "Oxana Hyder'");
044                                }
045                        }
046                        
047                };
048        }
049        
050}
